name: Virginia Tech
character: The main campus features neo-Gothic limestone and gray Hokie Stone buildings, green spaces including a duck pond and old-growth forest, and a central oval Drillfield.

landmarks.name: Drillfield
landmarks.quote: In the center of the Blacksburg campus lies the Drillfield, a large oval field running northeast to southwest
landmarks.look: A large oval grassy field encircled by a street.

landmarks.name: Upper Quad
landmarks.quote: North of the Drillfield and northwest of Alumni Mall lies the Upper Quad
landmarks.look: A campus quadrangle with cadet barracks and older buildings.

landmarks.name: Newman Library
landmarks.quote: Newman Library is on the eastern side of campus and connects to Torgersen Bridge
landmarks.look: A large neo-Gothic limestone library building.

landmarks.name: Torgersen Bridge
landmarks.quote: connects to Torgersen Bridge, which spans the main road into campus, Alumni Mall.
landmarks.look: An enclosed bridge spanning across a main campus road.

landmarks.name: Hahn Horticulture Garden
landmarks.quote: Notable green spaces include the Hahn Horticulture Garden, Virginia Tech Duck Pond
landmarks.look: A landscaped green garden space with plants and pathways.

landmarks.name: Virginia Tech Duck Pond
landmarks.quote: Notable green spaces include the Hahn Horticulture Garden, Virginia Tech Duck Pond
landmarks.look: A campus pond surrounded by green space.
